summary: A pipe package: @pulpfixer/pipe-<name>, scripted IO between a database and CSV files (or the other way), published to cellars

name.help: pf <name> runs it; lowercase letters, digits and dashes

input.prompt: Where the sample pipe reads from
input.help: the sample pipe `copy` starts from this kind of input

output.prompt: Where the sample pipe writes to
output.help: the sample pipe `copy` ends in this kind of output

connection.prompt: pf db connection it uses (when an end is a database)
connection.help: the name users give pf db add

next: pf a   (ask the agent to write the pipes: it follows AGENTS.md and the pipe-package skill)
pf ps  (publish @pulpfixer/pipe-{{name}} to cellars; asks first)
